readme:
# Plugin Cost Insights

Welcome to the cost insights plugin!

Cost insights is a plugin to visualize cloud cost.

## Install

```bash
# Run from backstage root directory
yarn packages/app add @devminified/plugin-cost-insights
```

## Configuration

Configure `app-config.yaml` file:

```yaml
// Other configuration
backend:
    baseUrl: http://localhost:7007
// Other configuration
```

## Usage

Import page from package and add route to access page

```ts
import { CostInsightsPage } from "@devminified/plugin-cost-insights";

/* remainig code */

const routes = (
    <FlatRoutes>
        /* Other routes */
        <Route path="/" element={<CostInsightsPage />} />
    </FlatRoutes>
)

/* remaining code */
```

_**Note:** This plugin depends on [`@devminified/plugin-cost-insights-backend`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@devminified/plugin-cost-insights-backend) - install and use that plugin in backend workspace_

## Add Sidebar Item

To expose page to users at `/cost-insights` add sidebar item

```ts
// packages/app/src/components/Root/Root.tsx
import MoneyIcon from "@material-ui/icons/MonetizationOn";

export const Root = ({ children }: PropsWithChildren<{}>) => (
    <SidebarPage>
        <Sidebar>
            // Other menu items
            <SidebarScrollWrapper>
                <SidebarItem
                  icon={MoneyIcon}
                  to="cost-insights"
                  text="Cost Insights"
                />
            </SidebarScrollWrapper>
            // Other menu items
        </Sidebar>
    </SidebarPage>
)
```
